photos/commons-korver-cavs-2017-erikdros.what: Kyle Korver (Cavaliers) shooting over Aaron Brooks, Monta Ellis below, far from the corner near the centre logo: an above-the-break three, 15 Feb 2017.

photos/commons-curry-warriors-at-wizards.what: Stephen Curry in the air on a jump shot, Marcin Gortat contesting, Warriors at Wizards 28 Feb 2017. Lane paint and rim behind.

photos/commons-curry-shooting-denver-201.what: Curry releasing a warm-up jumper in Denver, 2017; backup photo only (warm-up, not a game shot).

photos/commons-battier-heat-2012-scottme.what: Shane Battier with the Heat, 20 Dec 2012 (a famous corner shooter); spare.
